spec.name: Halloween Orange Wrapped Sweet
spec.description: A small orange Halloween sweet with a painted cream spiral, stepped candy body and pointed, pleated twist wrappers. Axis-aligned geometry occupies x0–16, y4–12, z4–12.

prompt: Small orange wrapped Halloween sweet with pointed twist wrappers and cream spiral centre, x0..16 y4..12 z4..12. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
